description: List the Shopify stores this server is configured for. Call it first: the aliases it returns are the store names every other tool takes (source, target, store). Returns { server, stores: [{ alias, domain, label, apiVersion, auth, allowWrites, protected }] }. allowWrites=false means apply_plan refuses that store; protected=true means a person confirms every apply to it. An empty list means no store is set up yet. Tokens and secrets are never returned. Takes no arguments and makes no Shopify calls. Next: list_resource_types for what can be synced, diff_stores to compare two stores.
name: list_stores
title: List configured stores
